Name: Charlie (Slightly Cuter Character Sprites)
Author: seanfletchr
Description:
Do you use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1437]Slightly Cuter Character Sprites[/url]? Are you also a fan of ﻿andril11’s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6027]Museum Expansion[/url]? This mod makes Charlie and Randy Slightly Cuter. His beach hairstyle is inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9847]OrangePieUwU’s portraits for Charlie[/url].

Full disclosure- I have not encountered Randy yet in my play through. I don’t know how his animations look in-game.

Features:[list]
[*]Ponytail.
[*]Bandanna.
[*]An Indiana Jones-inspired outfit.
[*]Nose? No nose? Who nose!
[/list]
Installation:
﻿- Download / Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1437]Slightly Cuter Character Sprites[/url]﻿ (SMAPI + Content Patcher)
﻿- Download / Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6027]Ancient History -  A Museum Expansion Mod[/url]
﻿- Put [CP] Slightly Cuter Characters - Charlie in your Mods folder
﻿- (Recommended) Use ﻿﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9847]OrangePie's DCBurger style Museum Expansion Portraits[/url]s
[color=#f1f1f1]﻿- Enjoy the new Museum Heartthrob.[/color]
